header.desc: Upload a video; speech is automatically transcribed, translated into Turkish and made available to download as Word and PDF.

info.privacy1: The uploaded video is deleted automatically once transcription ends (whether it succeeds or fails)
info.privacy2: Transcripts and translations belong to you alone
info.privacy4: Word and PDF can be saved optionally
